Chapter 227: Chapter 18: Despair Of Heiyu Ao

Chapter 227: Chapter 18: Despair of Heiyu Ao

“`

“These pieces of information…”

Lin Yuan rubbed his temples and even halted the act of integrating his life imprint into the universe. The information he received was obviously vast and exceedingly important.

“So, the ‘Door to the Myriad Realms’ in the depths of my mind is merely a projection of the true Door to the Myriad Realms.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged silently.

The real Door to the Myriad Realms was not something that a ‘frail’ and ‘insignificant’ life like Lin Yuan could sustain, even if the former had acknowledged him as its master. The disparity in levels between them was too great for them to coexist in the same space.

...

With Lin Yuan’s strength before stepping into the Sixth Rank, bearing a projection of the Door to the Myriad Realms was already his limit.

Even now, as Lin Yuan had evolved to a Sixth Rank Evolver, and his Life Essence had undergone transformation, making him capable of leaving a brand in the Main World,

he still could not sustain the real Door to the Myriad Realms. Of course, stepping into the Sixth Rank wasn’t without its changes.

The current Lin Yuan could carry a projection of the Door to the Myriad Realms, and its inherent essence had elevated much.

This point could be explained by the additional information about the ‘Door to the Myriad Realms’ that Lin Yuan acquired.

…

“World-Breaking Origin Force?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew somewhat solemn.

According to the information just received from the projection of the Door to the Myriad Realms, he knew that the World-Breaking Origin Force was one of the core energy sources of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

Every three hundred thirty-three days, the projection of the Door to the Myriad Realms could accumulate a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force from the void.

The specific manifestation was the lighting up of the peripheral area of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

Simply put,

A strand of World-Breaking Origin Force could allow Lin Yuan to travel once.

The uses of World-Breaking Origin Force were numerous.

Ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force could enable Lin Yuan to return once more to any world he had previously traversed.

This seemed rather good… Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Although, thus far, the four traversals he conducted all ended with Lin Yuan emerging invincible,

as the number of traversals increased and the levels of the worlds he visited were raised,

under the restriction of the Door to the Myriad Realms that limited the duration of stay, Lin Yuan couldn’t guarantee that he would be able to conquer every traversed world.

If there were any important treasures or things in the worlds that he hadn’t fully enjoyed, he could use this method to return to those realms and continue to enjoy them.

But that depended on the treasures or opportunities being sufficiently important, as ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force were enough for Lin Yuan to traverse ten times.

…

“Fifty strands of World-Breaking Origin Force can allow for physical traversal…”

Lin Yuan had long known that the Door to the Myriad Realms was not limited to Consciousness Descent but also allowed for physical traversal.

Though this method of traversal could establish a massive advantage early on, without the need for gradual cultivation, the risks were also greater.

If one were to perish in a traversed world, it would probably mean true death, which is far less forgiving than the opportunity for a do-over that Consciousness Descent offered.

“One hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force would allow me to choose the worlds for traversal, according to my desires.”

Meaning, Lin Yuan could control the type and direction of the worlds he traversed based on his own needs.

Such a utility was quite satisfying to Lin Yuan.

All the traversals conducted by the Door to the Myriad Realms thus far had been random.

Such traversals were not harmful in the early stages, but as Lin Yuan’s strength and realm continued to rise, some of the worlds he traversed wouldn’t provide much aid.

At this time, the effect of ‘customized’ traversal showed its value.

Lin Yuan could tailor a world that fit his cultivation system and could bring him immense aid.

“One hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force…too expensive…”

Given the Door to the Myriad Realms’ projection’s rate of accumulating one strand of World-Breaking Origin Force every three hundred thirty-three days,

One hundred strands would likely take ninety years.

“One thousand strands of World-Breaking Origin Force… can bring back an item from any of the traversed worlds…”

Lin Yuan sighed.

If one hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force already required waiting for over ninety years,

wouldn’t one thousand strands necessitate nearly a millennium?

Such use of World-Breaking Origin Force wouldn’t be considered by Lin Yuan unless it was for some special Origin Source treasure of a world.

“Ten thousand strands of World-Breaking Origin Force…”

Lin Yuan had not seen the specific effects of ten thousand strands of World-Breaking Origin Force, but according to the current information received, there should be use for such an amount.

…

“The current Door to the Myriad Realms projection, the accumulated ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’?”

Lin Yuan sensed it and found that the current amount of ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ was just over one strand.

“The accumulation of ‘World-Breaking Origin Force’ should be based on the standard of the Main World…”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and continued to start integrating a bit of his life brand into the universe.

…

Canglan Star.

Governor Song Wuyang stretched languidly.

“Governor, all matters have been dealt with, and what follows is your personal rest time,” came the voice of his AI assistant.

“Personal rest time?”

Song Wuyang’s face showed a smile.

Suddenly,

At that moment,

The voice of the AI assistant came through once again.

“Governor, Nolan Chenxi requests to speak with you.”

“Nolan Chenxi?” Song Wuyang suddenly tensed up.

The surname ‘Chenxi’ came from the strongest force in the Dawn Star System—the Dawn Association.

And Nolan Chenxi was the vice-chairman of the Dawn Association, a major figure in the Dawn Star System, second only to the chairman.

“Agree to the call.”

Song Wuyang took a deep breath to stabilize his emotions,

And immediately gave the command.

He was somewhat anxious, unsure why such a high-ranking individual was personally reaching out to him.

Now that Canglan Star had just recovered from the pressure exerted by the Heiyu Family,

He hoped there wouldn’t be any unexpected incident.

Hum.

The holographic screen before him,

Showed the image of Nolan Chenxi.

“I’ve seen Nolan, sir.”
